blocks.name: header
blocks.description: Site header. Loads nav content from a fragment page (default /nav, overridable via page metadata 'nav'). Splits the fragment's first three sections into nav-brand, nav-sections, nav-tools.
blocks.decorate_shape: Fetches nav fragment; builds <nav id="nav">; assigns brand/sections/tools classes by section index; marks any <li> containing a nested <ul> as .nav-drop; injects hamburger button; toggles at min-width 900px; wires Escape + focusout close and Enter/Space keyboard open.
blocks.example_structure: Fragment doc with 3 sections: (1) brand logo/link, (2) ul menu with optional nested ul submenus, (3) tools links

blocks.name: footer
blocks.description: Site footer. Loads footer content from a fragment page (default /footer, overridable via metadata 'footer').
blocks.decorate_shape: Fetches footer fragment, empties block, appends fragment children inside a single wrapper div. No structural transformation.
blocks.example_structure: Fragment doc with free-form default content (paragraphs, link lists)

blocks.name: hero
blocks.description: Full-width page intro. Image rendered as an absolutely-positioned background layer with an h1 overlaid on top.
blocks.decorate_shape: NO JavaScript (hero.js is empty). Presentation is CSS-only: .hero picture is position:absolute, z-index:-1, inset:0; h1 sits above it in normal flow and is coloured with --background-color.
blocks.example_structure: Single cell containing a picture and a heading

blocks.name: cards
blocks.description: Grid of cards, each with an optional image and a rich-text body.
blocks.decorate_shape: Converts block rows to <ul>/<li>; per cell, assigns .cards-card-image when the cell's only child is a <picture>, otherwise .cards-card-body; rewrites images through createOptimizedPicture at 750px.
blocks.example_structure: One row per card; cell 1 image, cell 2 rich text

signals.note: Text-only cards already degrade gracefully - every cell simply becomes .cards-card-body

blocks.name: columns
blocks.description: Responsive multi-column layout; column count derived from the first row.
blocks.decorate_shape: Adds .columns-N-cols from first row's child count; tags any column whose sole child is a picture as .columns-img-col.
blocks.example_structure: One row, N cells; each cell free-form content

blocks.name: fragment
blocks.description: Inlines another document's content at this position. The standard mechanism for content repeated across many pages.
blocks.decorate_shape: Reads path from the block's link href (or text), fetches {path}.plain.html, runs decorateMain + loadSections on it, replaces block children with the result.
blocks.example_structure: Single cell containing a link to the fragment document path
